sampling.policy: Uniform random sampling without replacement within each outcome group; equal groups capped by the smallest available group. No selection using map appearance.
sampling.limitation: Outcome-enriched review sample, not representative of disease prevalence, accuracy or attribution frequencies in the full cohort.

note: Patient IDs of the 132 sampled cases removed from this copy so the package cannot unblind the reader audit. The full record stays with the study coordinator.
